entities.summary: Alvydas Pazdrazdis is a Lithuanian former basketball player from Kretinga, Lithuania, who won the bronze medal with the Lithuania national basketball team at the 1992 Summer Olympics. He is currently a scout for the Dallas Mavericks. His former clubs include Statyba Vilnius, Neptūnas Klaipėda and Sakalai Vilnius. He retired as a player at the age of 28. In June 2011, he became an NBA champion as a scout with the Dallas Mavericks. He played collegiately at McNeese State University.
